documents.title: Refund eligibility
documents.text: Synthetic store refunds are available within 30 days of delivery when eligibility checks pass. The demo does not approve real refunds.

documents.title: Damaged product returns
documents.text: A damaged product may be returned. Report the damage within 7 days, keep the packaging, and request a return review. Synthetic support can explain the process but cannot issue payments.

documents.title: Order tracking
documents.text: Order status and delivery tracking are available using a synthetic DEMO order identifier. Use the order status lookup tool for the current stored status.

documents.title: Delivery delays
documents.text: A delivery delay can occur while an order is in transit. Review order tracking before contacting synthetic support.

documents.title: Payment methods
documents.text: The synthetic store documents card and voucher payment methods. Never provide actual card details to this demo.

documents.title: Return packaging
documents.text: Keep original packaging for a damaged product return. Include the synthetic order reference in the return request.

documents.title: Refund processing
documents.text: An eligible refund review may take five synthetic business days after a returned item is checked. This demonstration makes no real transfers.

documents.title: Canceling an order
documents.text: A processing order may be eligible for cancellation review. Delivered orders use the return process instead.

documents.title: Address updates
documents.text: Delivery address changes require a review before shipment. This read-only demonstration cannot update an address.

documents.title: Warranty support
documents.text: Synthetic warranty support explains replacement eligibility for manufacturing defects. No real customer records are accessed.

documents.title: Missing package
documents.text: For a missing package, check the delivery tracking and stored order status. A delivered status is not proof that the customer received the package.

documents.title: Privacy guidance
documents.text: Use only synthetic questions and demo order identifiers. Do not enter passwords, access credentials, personal addresses, or payment details.
